mechanism: Same as p2contp8 but the DirectContinuous guard is widened to `p ≤ 16` instead of `p ≤ 8`; p=2 leaves Cross. Tests whether the sparsely occurring p=9..16 cases also prefer the direct writer. No other runtime bytes change.
hypothesis: p=9..16 cases carry 4-8% of scored BMM work by seed; if direct wins there too the threshold can move without touching larger packed shapes.
proof: No new proof obligation: each edited `if` keeps both branches and their existing spec theorems; only the decidable predicate changes.

edits.old: if n ≤ 4 ∧ 2 < p then DirectContinuous.core batch m n p A B
edits.new: if (n ≤ 4 ∧ 2 < p) ∨ p ≤ 16 then DirectContinuous.core batch m n p A B
